observations.behavior: Adds a shared close-token and ownership tracking to prevent multiple tooltips from remaining open while sweeping the cursor.
observations.posthog_connection: In the MetricsView, when a user hovers over a chart row, this hunk assigns the tooltip's close function to a shared token and marks ownership. This prevents the next hovered row from retaining the previous tooltip's close token, which could otherwise keep an old tooltip alive while a new one is being positioned.
